judge.rationale: The candidate only generated the specification update, an acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`), and a planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), stopping before implementing any production code. `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` is completely untouched, so `lastUsage` is still overwritten rather than accumulated, the hook signature parameter is not updated to `totalUsage`, and the newly added test will fail immediately. Furthermore, `CHANGELOG.md` was not updated as required by the acceptance criteria. While the test and spec edits are reasonable, the core feature is completely unimplemented.
